Hotels.Name: Topazio Mar Beach Hotel and Apartments
Hotels.ItemName: Topazio Mar Beach Hotel and Apartments
Hotels.Description:
If you are looking for a perfect escape to a home-away-from-home in the sunshine, look no further. Your stylish room or apartment will have everything you need to provide you a base from which you can enjoy a fantastic holiday. If you do book an apartment, expect a tranquil oasis with a living area and kitchenette. You’ll be able to cook your own lovingly prepared meals and eat them in your own private space. If you do fancy a night off cooking, there are plenty of bars and restaurants in the local area.

With fantastic facilities and welcoming staff, you are sure to have a memorable holiday in the hotel’s grounds. Begin your day with a delicious meal in the restaurant to prepare you for your day of holidaying. Fill your time here with days spent relaxing by the pool with a good book and basking in the sunshine. The glistening pool provides a welcomed oasis, perfect for refreshing dips. If the beach is more your scene, head down to the golden sands. Relax in the splendour of the natural surroundings while you listen to the sound of the waves gently lap at the shoreline. You are sure to have a holiday to remember at this fantastic hotel with apartments.

Please note: this hotel does not accept stag/hen parties or similar groups.
